summary.content:
Today's selection covers 66 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 48 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Saudis Aided Family of Engineer Accused of Bugging OpenAI, Prosecutors Say
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, TechCrunch, Krebs on Security, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 52 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.title: Saudis Aided Family of Engineer Accused of Bugging OpenAI, Prosecutors Say
top.description: Saudi officials paid for his wife and son to fly out of the U.S. and offered to cover his bail, according to court filings. A judge ordered the engineer to remain in custody.
